title: बरगद की डायन का रहस्य 😱 | Indian Folk Horror #shorts
description:
अमावस की रात पुराने बरगद के पेड़ के नीचे क्या हुआ? देखिए इस रोंगटे खड़े करने वाले लोक रहस्य को। क्या राजू बच पाएगा?

#horror #bhoot #chudail #folklore #shorts
style: Cinematic Indian folk horror style, dark atmospheric lighting, eerie volumetric moonlight, misty night village setting, intense suspense, hyper-detailed 9:16 vertical composition.

characters.name: Raju
characters.look: 22-year-old Indian village youth with short messy hair, terrified expression, wearing a mustard yellow kurta and off-white pajama, pushing a vintage black bicycle.

characters.name: Daayan
characters.look: Terrifying Indian village folklore witch, ashen grey skin, sunken glowing eyes, tangled long black hair, draped in a tattered crimson red saree, twisted backwards feet.

scenes.speaker: narrator
scenes.narration: अमावस की रात उस पुराने बरगद के नीचे कभी मत रुकना।
scenes.image_prompt: Cinematic Indian folk horror style, vertical 9:16. A massive ancient cursed banyan tree at midnight on a moonless night, sprawling twisted roots and hanging aerial vines, dense eerie blue fog surrounding the base, chilling darkness with distant glowing red orbs in the branches.

scenes.speaker: narrator
scenes.narration: राजू अपनी साइकिल से सुनसान पगडंडी पर तेजी से जा रहा था।
scenes.image_prompt: Cinematic Indian folk horror style, vertical 9:16. Raju, a 22-year-old Indian youth in a mustard yellow kurta and white pajama, pedaling an old black bicycle rapidly along a desolate dirt pathway flanked by high dry bushes under dark misty night sky.

scenes.speaker: narrator
scenes.narration: अचानक बरगद की डाल से घुंघरुओं की छन-छन सुनाई दी।
scenes.image_prompt: Cinematic Indian folk horror style, vertical 9:16. Raju stops his bicycle abruptly beneath the looming banyan tree, looking terrified toward the dark upper branches, glowing brass ghungroo ankle bells faintly swaying from a thick twisted branch shrouded in mist.

scenes.speaker: narrator
scenes.narration: उसने ऊपर देखा, एक औरत लाल साड़ी में उल्टी लटकी थी!
scenes.image_prompt: Cinematic Indian folk horror style, vertical 9:16. Looking up from Raju's perspective into the twisted branches of the banyan tree, the Daayan hanging upside down like a bat, wearing a tattered crimson red saree, long black hair dangling downwards, glowing red eyes staring directly down.

scenes.speaker: narrator
scenes.narration: डर के मारे राजू ने साइकिल की रफ्तार दोगुनी कर दी।
scenes.image_prompt: Cinematic Indian folk horror style, vertical 9:16. Fast-paced camera angle showing Raju furiously pedaling his bicycle away from the cursed banyan tree, sweat dripping down his terrified pale face, bicycle light flickering weakly into the dark foggy road.

scenes.speaker: narrator
scenes.narration: तभी सामने वही औरत खड़ी मिली, डरावनी मुस्कान के साथ।
scenes.image_prompt: Cinematic Indian folk horror style, vertical 9:16. The bicycle headlight suddenly illuminates the Daayan standing blocked in the middle of the narrow dirt path, dressed in a torn red saree, head tilted unnaturally with an uncanny sinister grin, mist swirling around her.

scenes.speaker: narrator
scenes.narration: राजू की नज़र नीचे पड़ी... उसके पैर पूरी तरह उल्टे थे!
scenes.image_prompt: Cinematic Indian folk horror style, vertical 9:16. Dramatic low-angle close-up shot of the dusty dirt ground, showing the pale, dust-covered feet of the Daayan protruding from beneath her red saree, heels facing completely forward and toes pointing backwards in classic folklore horror.

scenes.speaker: woman
scenes.image_prompt: Cinematic Indian folk horror style, vertical 9:16. Terrifying extreme close-up of the Daayan's face in the dark, pale decayed skin, pitch-black veins, widely stretched mouth with sharp yellowed teeth, screaming with glowing demonic eyes into the viewer's face.

scenes.speaker: narrator
scenes.narration: राजू की जेब में वही लाल कंगन जलने लगा!
scenes.image_prompt: Cinematic Indian folk horror style, vertical 9:16. Raju clutching his kurta pocket in agonizing terror as an intense crimson fire-like glow and smoke burst through the fabric of his yellow kurta pocket, lighting his screaming face with harsh red light.

scenes.speaker: narrator
scenes.narration: और हवा में फिर वही चेतावनी गूंजी...
scenes.image_prompt: Cinematic Indian folk horror style, vertical 9:16. Raju's abandoned bicycle lying on the deserted dirt road under the ominous twisted banyan tree, swirling dark mist, no trace of the boy, only a floating red saree veil in the cold wind, cycling back into endless terror.

format: Indian folk horror: chudail, bhoot, pishach, daayan or a cursed well / tree from village stories
